ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio with approximately 80-85% low-intensity black pixels and 15-20% high-intensity white pixels localized primarily at the distal tips and upper margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity region centered and extending to the lower peduncle. High-intensity white contiguous blobs are mapped to the upper 15% of the left lobe and the distal 20% of the right lobe. Diffuse high-intensity mottling is scattered across the mid-section of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 72 degrees; vertical depth of the notch extends approximately 12% into the total vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entire trailing boundary. Peak-to-valley amplitudes vary between 5 to 20 pixels, with more pronounced jagged topography on the right lobe compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve profile observed on the trailing edge extending from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (5-15 pixel diameter) detected, primarily localized on the distal margins and within the black pigmented central regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) mapped across the central and left lobe regions, showing multi-directional orientation and cutting across primary black pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Evidence of significant linear scarring (rake marks) and irregular micro-nicks along the trailing edge topography.
